subject: Mobile Development
title: Symbian: The Forgotten Leader
description: A quick, practical guide to Symbian: The Forgotten Leader.

hook.text: Before iOS and Android, the world's most popular smartphone OS was Symbian.

buildup.text: Nokia, Sony Ericsson, and Samsung all shipped phones running Symbian in the 2000s.

discovery.text: At its peak in 2006, Symbian held over 70% of the global smartphone market.

twist.text: Symbian's code was a tangled mess from the 1990s. Adding new features was painfully slow.

climax.text: By 2012, Symbian's market share had collapsed to near zero. Technical debt killed it.

punchline.text: The market leader drowned in its own code.

quiz.question: What killed Symbian?
options: Massive technical debt from old code
